newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Hungary forint eases vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: Hungary forint eases vs dlr.

text.p: Hungary's forint ended weaker against the dollar on Wednesday but little changed against the currency basket, dealers said.
The Hungarian unit weakened to 177.40/45 to the US unit from an opening 176.95/177.00 and a noon level of 177.20/25 as the dollar mark showed strength on European markets.
"I can say that the Fed (rate) hike had no impact, mainly because the move had already been counted in," said Marton Kis of OTP Bank.
Sterling's strength in international markets didn't affect the forint market, which was inactive, he added.

Sterling is not part of the currency basket against which the forint floats. The Hungarian unit moves within the central bank's 4.5 percent wide intervention range against a basket made up 30 percent of the dollar and 70 percent of the mark.
